MY SHAPE STUDIO

Build a Shape Picture

Arrange your paper shapes, then create a picture of your own.

Look, then try.

On paper, place the largest pieces first and glue only when you like the arrangement. On screen, draw your shapes in the box below; this is a drawing space, not a drag-and-drop puzzle. You can turn or overlap shapes in your design.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Create with a grown-up. An adult helps with cutting. Use child-safe glue, keep small scraps out of mouths and keep devices away from glue.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

ACTIVITY 1

My shape picture

Draw your own collage design, or record the collage you made on paper.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

Composition means choosing where things go in a picture. Overlap can make one shape appear in front of another.

Prefer a worksheet?

Open the individual cartoon activity sheet to print or save. Use portrait orientation and fit to page.
